title: Rand Paul confronts Fauci over the gain-of-function definition

tellings.quote: So what you're doing is defining away gain of function. You're simply saying it doesn't exist because you changed the definition on the NIH website.

plain: In a 2021 Senate hearing in Washington, Senator Rand Paul accused Anthony Fauci, then the government's top infectious disease official, of hiding gain-of-function research, meaning work that makes viruses more dangerous, by changing what the word means. "You're simply saying it doesn't exist because you changed the definition on the NIH website," Paul says, the NIH being the National Institutes of Health, the US agency that funds medical research. Michels brings up the exchange as an example of officials redefining words to avoid admitting something.
